usageNotes: Use this endpoint to inspect a remote URL's file size, filename, and MIME type before initiating a download — for example, to validate an ISO or cloud image URL before passing it to a storage import job. The request is made by the target node, so the node must be online and able to reach the URL. Disable certificate verification (`verify-certificates: false`) only for trusted internal sources with self-signed certs, as it bypasses TLS validation.

examples.summary: Check metadata for a Debian cloud image before importing to storage

tips: All three return fields (filename, mimetype, size) are optional — the remote server may omit any of them depending on its HTTP headers.
A returned size of 0 or a missing size field may indicate the server does not send a Content-Length header; do not assume the file is empty.
Requires either Sys.Audit or Sys.Modify at root, or Sys.AccessNetwork scoped to the specific node — the node-scoped privilege is the least-privilege path.
